title: Fabric Dim
description: The published wire/cache shape of a single fabric dim. A dim is a first-class fabric definition (like a cap, a media def or an alias): one axis along which definitions vary, such as a language, a file type or a quantisation, with the values it may take. Cap and media definitions name the dims they were built from, and the value chosen from each, in their `dims`; what a dim and each of its values mean is documented here, once, and a reader shows it beside the definition's own documentation. Stored at dims/<sha256-of-name>/<defver>.json and referenced from a manifest's `dims` map (name -> defver).

name.description: The dim's name, unique across the snapshot. Definitions refer to the dim by it.

version.description: Per-definition version. Dims exist only in the versioned regime; there is no v0 flat-path dim. Raised when anything in this body changes.

documentation.description: Markdown documentation of what the dim is: the axis, and how its values differ.

values.description: The values the dim may take, in the order the dim declares them. Value names are unique within the dim.

name.description: The value's name, unique within the dim. A definition's `dims` entry names the value by it.

title.description: Display-friendly title of the value. Generated definition titles carry it.

tags.description: The tags the value contributes to the URN of every definition built with it.

value.description: The tag's value; '*' for a marker tag (present, without a value).

documentation.description: Markdown documentation of this value: what choosing it means. Absent when the dim's documentation says all there is.

media_type.description: The MIME media type the value gives the media defs built with it.

extensions.description: The file extensions the value gives the media defs built with it, without the leading dot.
